Louise —

A couple finance/contract clarifications from our side:
1) Platform fee amortization: We structure the platform fee as a monthly service charge; for accounting purposes some customers capitalize it as an OPEX amortized service. We can provide language that clarifies non-transfer of control-plane IP and scope of the fee.
2) Escrow mechanics: Our standard approach is to use a neutral third-party escrow agent (we have a preferred provider) and limit escrow assets to deployment scripts, configuration manifests, and a small set of runbooks. We mark any release conditions as insolvency, extended failure to support (>180 days), or explicit court order. We will not put model weights, customer telemetry, or internal kernel code into escrow.
3) Billing: Implementation credits are applied as invoice credits on the first two billing cycles; if you require a different amortization (e.g., apply across 6 months), we can accommodate with contract language.

Next steps I recommend:
- Jordan: propose a short mutual action plan with dates (procurement review, legal review, signature target).
- Louise: confirm whether MediaLabs legal needs example escrow wording or a call with our legal ops (we can set up that call).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao\Director, Finance & Commercial Operations\Redwood Inference
